id.description: Unique identifier of the person, workspace or virtual line to be monitored.

lastName.description: Last name of the monitored person, workspace or virtual line.

firstName.description: First name of the monitored person, workspace or virtual line.

displayName.description: Display name of the monitored person, workspace or virtual line.

type.description: Indicates whether type is person, workspace or virtual line.

email.description: Email address of the monitored person, workspace or virtual line.

numbers.description: List of phone numbers of the monitored person, workspace or virtual line.
